# Prolewatch 0.12.0

`0.12.0` is the first public experimental release of Prolewatch. It has not
been independently audited and should be evaluated on an isolated Arch Linux
system before it is trusted with routine AUR builds.

- Prolewatch is not on the AUR, and this release has no maintainer-signed source
  path.
- The supported installation is from a reviewed source checkout on x86-64 Arch
  Linux, using `make dev-install` to build, locally sign, verify, and install an
  Arch package.
- The attached Linux amd64 binaries, SBOMs, and binary archive are verification
  artifacts, not supported installable distributions. No arm64 artifact is
  published for this first release.
